title: Veloce: Post-Quantum Cryptography SDK
description: Veloce combines cryptographic discovery and CBOM reporting with a local post-quantum cryptography agent, Python SDK, and command-line interface. The current release is publicly downloadable and free to use under the Lightrider Inc license included with the release; no client subscription is required for this archived version. Future managed services, enterprise features, support, updates, or client releases may require a paid subscription. Public access does not make Veloce OSI open source or override the included license. Built with wolfCrypt (FIPS 140-3 certificate #4718); wolfSSL components are distributed as object code only under commercial license.
